titles.title: Fire
titles.plot: Sita and Radha are two Indian women stuck in loveless marriages. While Sita is trapped in an arranged relationship with her cruel and unfaithful husband, Jatin, Radha is married to his brother, Ashok, a religious zealot who believes in suppressing desire. As the two women recognize their similar situations, they grow closer, and their relationship becomes far more involved than either of them could have anticipated.

titles.title: A Simple Curve
titles.plot: Jim (Michael Hogan), a former hippie, runs a small woodworking business with his son Caleb (Kris Lemche) in a remote Canadian town. He disdains money and cares only about the artistry of his craftsmanship, leaving practical Caleb to prevent them from going bankrupt. One day, Matthew (Matt Craven), an old family friend who joined the corporate world, makes Caleb an offer that could be very profitable, as long as they can keep it a secret from the disapproving Jim.

titles.title: A Peck on the Cheek
titles.plot: On her ninth birthday Amudha (P.S. Keerthana), after learning that she was adopted, resolves to find her birth mother. Her parents Thiruchelvan (Madhavan) and Indra (Simran) insist on accompanying her, and so together they leave the comfort of their home in India to venture into the jungles of Sri Lanka, where they witness the violence and brutality of civil war. Eventually they discover Shyama (Nandita Das), who explains that she gave up her daughter to fight for the separatist cause.

titles.title: Paa
titles.plot: A politician's 13-year-old son has a rare disorder that makes him appear to be a grown man.

titles.title: 33 Postcards
titles.plot: A Chinese orphan (Zhu Lin) meets her longtime Australian sponsor (Guy Pearce) and discovers that he leads a far less idyllic life than his postcards to her suggest.

titles.title: A Way of Life
titles.plot: With both social services and her daughter's paternal grandmother (Brenda Blethyn) threatening to assume guardianship of her child, single teen mom Leigh-Anne (Stephanie James) becomes increasingly paranoid under the constant pressure. But Leigh-Anne's environment -- one of crime and poverty -- is no place to raise a child, nor does she have the legitimate means to do so. When she fears that her neighbor (Oliver Haden) is talking to social services, her destructive behavior only increases.

titles.title: To Life
titles.plot: Three women who met in Auschwitz reunite 15 years later during a seaside holiday.

titles.title: A Long Way From Home
titles.plot: A bored British retiree (James Fox) becomes increasingly drawn to a pair of young tourists who remind him of himself in his younger days.

titles.title: A Raisin in the Sun
titles.plot: Lena Younger (Phylicia Rashad) receives a settlement from her husband's life insurance policy and then must decide what to do with the money. She wants to move out of their apartment into a house in a more genteel neighborhood. Her eldest son, Walter (Sean Combs), aspires to be an entrepreneur. Daughter Beneatha (Sanaa Lathan) hopes to go to medical school. Though their aspirations collide, they try to find a way to retain their family's cohesion.

titles.title: A Simple Life
titles.plot: A film producer (Andy Lau) helps care for his family's lifelong servant (Deanie Ip) after she suffers a stroke and must move into a nursing home.

titles.title: ABCD 2
titles.plot: Childhood friends Suresh and Vinnie want to become successful dancers. To fulfill their dreams, they form a dance group with their friends and compete in a hip-hop contest in Las Vegas.

titles.title: All the Light in the Sky
titles.original_title: All the Light in the Sky
titles.plot: A visit from her young niece (Sophia Takal) prompts a middle-aged actress (Jane Adams) whose career is on the wane to ponder the state of her life.

images.caption: All the Light in the Sky (2012)
All the Light in the Sky (2012)

titles.title: Archipelago
titles.plot: A family's deep fractures begin to surface during a vacation on the Isles of Scilly.

titles.title: Chain
titles.plot: Two women from disparate social and economic backgrounds spend a great deal of their time exploring modern industrial landscapes, but for very different reasons. Successful Japanese businesswoman Tamiko (Miho Nikaido) was hired by a real estate corporation to study malls, amusement parks and resorts. Homeless teen Amanda Timms (Mira Billotte), who spends most of her time randomly filming and pondering her surroundings, wanders the same areas because she has nowhere else to go.

titles.title: Dead Europe
titles.plot: Isaac travels across Europe to spread his father's ashes from a Greek mountaintop.

titles.title: Dry Season
titles.plot: A youth's (Ali Barkai) grandfather (Khayar Oumar Defallah) charges him with tracking down and executing the man (Youssouf Djaoro) who killed his father.

titles.title: Exhibition
titles.plot: An artist couple's living and working patterns are disrupted by the imminent sale of their house.

titles.title: Ezra
titles.plot: Rebels force a 9-year-old boy to fight in a civil war in Sierra Leone.

titles.title: Fathers of Girls
titles.plot: A doting father must come to terms with his daughter's dark side after something happens to her when she moves out to attend college.

titles.title: The Fighting Sullivans
titles.plot: In this dramatization of a true story, five brothers from Iowa (James Cardwell, John Campbell, George Offerman Jr., John Alvin, Edward Ryan) grow up in an inseparable family during the Great Depression. When World War II strikes the country, the brothers feel compelled to serve their nation in its time of need. After joining the Navy, the siblings request to serve on the same ship -- a decision that turns out to be devastating for the family when their vessel is attacked at Guadalcanal.

titles.title: Fireworks Wednesday
titles.plot: Upon hearing of the engagement of her housekeeper, Roohi, housewife Mozhde sends the betrothed to enjoy free services at a local salon -- provided that she eavesdrop to verify suspicions that her wealthy husband, Morteza, is having an affair. But when -- in a misguided attempt to mend the Samieis' impossibly broken marriage -- Roohi ignores Mozhde's instructions, her naive meddling may throw the couple even deeper into turmoil.

titles.title: Flint
titles.plot: A woman deals with the toxic water crisis in Flint, Mich., and its effect on her family.

titles.title: Free Radicals
titles.plot: Residents of a small Austrian town are touched by the death of a young woman (Kathrin Resetarits) whose presence remains long after her funeral.

titles.title: Garden Party
titles.plot: In Los Angeles a girl (Willa Holland) falls in with a group of other teens who are trying to fulfill their dreams.

titles.title: Gebo and the Shadow
titles.plot: An honored and poor patriarch sacrifices himself to save his son.

titles.title: Happy Hour
titles.plot: Three women search for their friend after she goes missing.

titles.title: Iron Island
titles.plot: A slowly sinking ship stuck in the Persian Gulf has become a pseudo-community to homeless Iranian squatters. This metal metropolis is run by Capt. Nemat (Ali Nassirian), a firm but loving leader who does everything from play Cupid to supervise the residents' search for salable scrap metal. The only person in this town not to obey the captain's every command is Ahmad (Hossein Farzi-Zadeh), a rebellious youngster who pines for a pretty girl (Neda Pakdaman) with an overprotective father.

titles.title: Jealousy
titles.plot: A theater actor is torn between the woman he loves and the woman he lives with.

titles.title: Late September
titles.plot: A woman throws a party for her husband; as the hours pass, old rifts, new relationships and secrets emerge among the attendees, causing underlying tensions in the marriage to erupt.

titles.title: Life in a Fishbowl
titles.plot: Three people leading double lives make difficult changes to find redemption.

titles.title: Lizzie Borden Took an Ax
titles.plot: In 1892, Lizzie Borden (Christina Ricci) stands trial for the brutal murder of her father and stepmother.

titles.title: The Heirs
titles.plot: Spurred by boredom and peer pressure, a group of suburban teens becomes increasingly violent and find their paths intersecting those of their parents.

titles.title: The Nobodies
titles.plot: Five friends survive at the edges of the city.

titles.title: Magnifico
titles.plot: A boy (Jiro Manio) builds a coffin for his terminally ill grandmother, while raising money to buy a wheelchair for his sister.

titles.title: Man Push Cart
titles.plot: Ahmad (Ahmad Razvi) is a Pakistani-born cart vendor who sells bagels and coffee in Manhattan, a humble and bleak means of living that affords him little comfort. In his former life in Pakistan, he was a rock star. He was also married and had a child. Now his wife is dead, his in-laws refuse him visits with his son, and his job is all he seems to have, but he seems content with his fate. However, a chance encounter with a businessman may change Ahmad's fortune -- for better or worse.

images.caption: A scene from the film "Man Push Cart."

titles.title: Maqbool
titles.plot: In Mumbai's criminal underworld, the lord of all lords is Jahangir Khan (Pankaj Kapoor). Those loyal to him include Maqbool (Irfan Khan), his chief. But Maqbool is in love with Nimmi (Tabu), Jahangir's mistress, who convinces him to be ambitious and take over the empire. After maneuvering potential rivals out of the way, Maqbool betrays Jahangir, murdering him in his own bed. However, it isn't long before both Maqbool and Nimmi are haunted by the ghosts of their treacherous deeds.

titles.title: Marathon
titles.plot: A New York woman (Sara Paul) boards subways and buses in an attempt to solve more than 77 crossword puzzles in 24 hours.

titles.title: Michael
titles.plot: An insurance executive (Michael Fuith) keeps a 10-year-old boy (David Rauchenberger) captive in his basement.

titles.title: My House in Umbria
titles.plot: After surviving a gruesome terrorist attack on an Italian train line, romance novelist Emily Delahunty (Maggie Smith) opens up her home and solitary life to a trio of stranded survivors. She soon forms friendships with each, but develops a special attachment to the young orphan Aimee (Emmy Clarke). So when Aimee's distant uncle (Chris Cooper) arrives to retrieve the girl, Emily strives to convince the cold, mourning man that Umbria is Aimee's rightful home.

titles.title: Nana
titles.plot: Nana is a 4-year-old girl who lives in the French countryside; she returns home from school one afternoon and finds only silence.

titles.title: Palo Alto
titles.plot: A lack of parental guidance encourages teens in an affluent California town to rebel with substance abuse and casual sex.

titles.title: People That Are Not Me
titles.plot: A young woman living in Tel Aviv yearns for intimacy but is also terrified by it.

titles.title: Personal Affairs
titles.plot: An elderly Israeli couple live in dull routine while, elsewhere, their grown children struggle with life's contradictions.

titles.title: The Amazing Truth About Queen Raquela
titles.original_title: The Amazing Truth About Queen Raquela
titles.plot: A transsexual (Raquela Rios) turns to the lucrative world of Internet porn to finance her dream of moving to Paris.

titles.title: She, a Chinese
titles.plot: Mei feels trapped in her small village and moves to London, where her entrapment begins anew when she marries an older man.

titles.title: The Adopted
titles.plot: Marie patches things up with her friend, Lisa, after a new boyfriend causes friction. Then just as things begin to settle down, Marie is struck by a motorcycle and falls into a coma, from which she is unlikely to awake.

titles.title: The Banishment
titles.plot: A trip to the countryside reveals dark secrets for a family.

titles.title: The Citizen
titles.plot: A Hungarian woman and a refugee form a deep bond.

titles.title: The King of Masks
titles.plot: In 1930s China, aging street performer Wang (Zhu Xu) yearns for a male heir to inherit the secrets of his renowned magical act. Though he refuses an offer to join the opera, he heeds the advice of female-impersonating opera star Liang (Zhang Zhigang) to find an heir. Wang soon buys an 8-year-old orphan named Doggie (Zhou Renying). When his new heir reveals a desperate secret, Wang must choose between following the strictures of society and the fatherly love he feels for his new protégé.

titles.title: The Middle of the World
titles.plot: An unemployed truck driver and his family bicycle nearly 2,000 miles across Brazil to find a job that pays a decent salary.

titles.title: The Mission
titles.plot: Boss Lung (Ko Hung) knows that someone in the Hong Kong Triad wants him dead. After a botched assassination nearly takes his life, he orders his right-hand man to recruit a group of expert bodyguards (Anthony Wong, Francis Ng, Roy Cheung, Lam Suet, Jackie Lui) to protect him from any further attacks. The hired gunmen quickly form a brotherhood, but their loyalty is tested when Lung discovers that one of them is having an affair with his wife, and he orders the others to kill him.

titles.title: The Rats
titles.plot: In central Spain in the 1950s, a boy (Álvaro Monje) lives with his widowed father (José Caride) on the outskirts of a poverty-stricken village.

titles.title: Tiger Cruise
titles.plot: Cmdr. Gary Dolan (Bill Pullman) is in charge of a naval carrier that is on a "tiger cruise," which involves family members joining their seafaring relatives out on the ocean. Dolan's precocious young daughter, Maddie (Hayden Panettiere), is along on the cruise, partially to convince her father to take a position that involves less travel. However, family dynamics suddenly take a backseat when word reaches the ship that the September 11 attacks have occurred.

titles.title: Time Share
titles.plot: Two haunted family men join forces in a destructive crusade to rescue their families from a tropical paradise after becoming convinced that an American timeshare conglomerate has a sinister plan to take their loved ones away.

titles.title: Tomboy
titles.plot: A 10-year-old girl (Zoé Héran) moves into a new neighborhood and decides to dress like a boy.

titles.title: Unveiled
titles.plot: Iranian interpreter Fariba (Jasmin Tabatabai) escapes to Germany to avoid capital punishment for homosexual activity, but her application for political asylum is denied. Awaiting deportation, Fariba gains a new identity when fellow Iranian refugee Siamak (Navid Akhavan) kills himself. Disguising herself as a male, Fariba is released from detention as Siamak. Fariba begins working in a small-town factory while saving money for a fake passport that will let her live as a woman again.

titles.title: Wisconsin Death Trip
titles.plot: The late 19th century finds the town of Black River Falls experiencing a wave of disturbing, macabre and truly eccentric occurrences. Perhaps the town's economic troubles or the harsh Wisconsin climate contribute to the plague of murder, arson, insanity, disease, suicide and other ills the cursed citizens endure. Part archival investigation, part dramatization, this film resurrects the demons of Black River Falls through bleak photographs and re-enactments of the town's sordid news articles.

titles.title: Women Without Men
titles.plot: The streets of Tehran, Iran, are teeming with protesters objecting to the overthrow of the prime minister, but four disparate women have more immediate concerns. Farrokhlagha's (Arita Shahrzad) husband thinks he's entitled to be married to multiple women. Munis (Shabnam Toloui) is a virtual slave to her brother. Faezeh (Pegah Ferydoni) has physical and emotional troubles. And Zarin (Orsolya Tóth) is an unwilling prostitute. Boldly, the women pursue solutions to the problems foisted upon them.

titles.title: Made in Hong Kong
titles.plot: After his father abandons the family, Autumn Moon (Sam Lee) drops out of high school and becomes a money collector for organized criminals the Triads. On his rounds, he meets and falls in love with Ping (Neiky Yim Hui-Chi), a daughter of one of the Triads' debtors. She is suffering from a fatal kidney disease, and to pay for her medical expenses, Autumn Moon takes an assassination contract, but as he slips deeper into the criminal underworld, he's haunted by a figure from his past.

titles.title: Me Too
titles.plot: A recent university graduate with Down syndrome falls in love -- on his first day at work -- with Laura, a woman who spends her nights in the city's crowded clubs and singles bars. The two begin a bittersweet friendship that puts them both on the road to happiness.
